chunks.doc_title: Scaler Academy: Software Development Program
chunks.section_path: Scaler Academy: Software Development Program > 2. Core Curriculum Modules
chunks.content:
[Document: courses/scaler_academy_software_development.md | Section: Scaler Academy: Software Development Program > 2. Core Curriculum Modules]
- **Module 1: Programming Constructs & Problem Solving**: Time and space complexity analysis, recursion, bit manipulation, arrays, and basic strings.
- **Module 2: Advanced Data Structures & Algorithms (DSA)**: Trees, Binary Search Trees, Tries, Heaps, Dynamic Programming (1D & 2D), Graphs, Greedy Algorithms, and Backtracking.
- **Module 3: Low-Level Design (LLD) & Object-Oriented Programming (OOP)**: Design patterns (Singleton, Factory, Strategy, Observer, Decorator), SOLID principles, UML diagrams, schema design, and concurrency in Java/C++/Python.
- **Module 4: High-Level System Design (HLD)**: Scalability fundamentals, load balancing, caching strategies (Redis, Memcached), database sharding & replication, message queues (Kafka, RabbitMQ), Microservices vs Monoliths, Rate limiters, URL shortener design, and distributed tracing.
- **Module 5: Full Stack Web Specialization (Elective)**: React.js, Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, RESTful APIs, WebSockets, Docker, and CI/CD pipelines.

chunks.doc_title: Scaler Data Science and Machine Learning Program
chunks.section_path: Scaler Data Science and Machine Learning Program > 2. Curriculum Roadmap
chunks.content:
[Document: courses/scaler_data_science_and_machine_learning.md | Section: Scaler Data Science and Machine Learning Program > 2. Curriculum Roadmap]
- **Module 1: Mathematics & Applied Statistics for Data Science**: Linear algebra, matrix operations, multivariate calculus, probability distributions, hypothesis testing, A/B testing frameworks, and confidence intervals.
- **Module 2: Python, SQL & Data Wrangling**: Advanced Pandas, NumPy, visualization with Seaborn/Plotly, complex SQL queries, window functions, and data cleaning pipelines.
- **Module 3: Supervised & Unsupervised Machine Learning**: Linear/Logistic Regression, Decision Trees, Random Forests, XGBoost, LightGBM, K-Means Clustering, PCA, t-SNE, and feature engineering techniques.
- **Module 4: Deep Learning, Computer Vision & NLP**: Neural networks from scratch with PyTorch and TensorFlow, CNNs (ResNet, YOLO), RNNs, Transformers, BERT, LLM fine-tuning, and prompt engineering.
- **Module 5: MLOps and Production Systems**: Model deployment with FastAPI, containerization with Docker, MLflow for experiment tracking, and AWS/GCP cloud model hosting.

- **Top Performers**: Learners who achieve top 5% rank in the entrance assessment receive merit scholarships ranging from ₹15,000 to ₹35,000.
- Scholarships are credited directly against the final course fee invoice and cannot be redeemed for cash.

chunks.content:
[Document: policies/scholarships_and_financial_aid.md | Section: Scaler Scholarships and Financial Aid Options > 3. Financing & EMI Plans]
- **No-Cost EMI Options**: Scaler partners with leading financial institutions and NBFCs (including Propelld, LiquiLoans, Eduvanz, and HDFC Bank) to provide 0% interest EMI tenures of 6, 9, and 12 months.
- **Extended EMI Plans**: Low-interest EMI plans are available for up to 24 and 36 months for working professionals seeking flexible monthly commitments.
- **Documentation Requirements for Loan Approval**: Government ID (Aadhaar / Passport), PAN Card, and latest 3 months' bank statements / salary slips.
